title: Unit equations for specified integral and rational scalar comparisons
statement: Fix a prime ell, an algebraic closure Omega/Q_ell, the actual small coefficient models of its finite subextensions [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-pod-isomorphism-coefficient-inclusions], and a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y with ell invertible. Let F_E denote completed integral pullback and T^W_{L/E} the completed scalar transition [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Let alpha_{L/E}:F_E T^X_{L/E}≅T^Y_{L/E} F_L be any family of natural isomorphisms whose components equal the prescribed integralPullbackScalarComparison. For each finite subextension E and integral constructible K on Y, alpha_{E/E,K} followed by F_E(u^Y_K) equals u^X_{F_E K}, where u is the canonical integral scalar unitor transported along the actual inclusion-identity law [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. The corresponding equation holds for the prescribed rational pullback comparison and the canonical rational unitor on every raw rational object. No stage, shift, exactness or tower existence is asserted.

source.place: Proof, final sentence on automorphism pullback: completed-to-termwise comparison, t-exactness, and rational scalar/shift coherence (previous steps 8-9); agent extraction of the existing corrected stage-1 argument, not a quoted theorem of the blueprint

proof.text:
First use the supplied component normalization of alpha, and congrArg Iso.hom, to replace each of its components by the prescribed integral comparison. Then apply the original normalized-map argument. Use the scalarIdentity field of a normalized integral comparison system.
The comparison-agreement theorem identifies its whole-system map with the prescribed
completed comparison. The normalized scalar unit is ordinary multiplication, conjugated
by completion, so the identity equation is precisely the displayed integral unit law.
Apply the integral-to-rational functor: the prescribed rational comparison and rational
scalar unitor are its images componentwise. Their fixed object formulas identify all
endpoints; functoriality transfers the equation. No morphism is discarded, including
integral torsion morphisms, whose images may vanish. Transport the unit or tower equation along coefficientInclusion_laws in the small coefficient models. The rational adapters are exactly GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.unitor and its normalized associator.

theorem isomorphismPullbackUnitLaws
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (α : ∀ (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L),
      constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g ⋙
        GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.integralTransition l Ω X E L h ≅
      GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.integralTransition l Ω Y E L h ⋙
        constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) g)
    (hα : ∀ (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L)
      (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y),
      (α E L h).app K = integralPullbackScalarComparison l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
        (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) (isomorphismCoefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) g K) :
    (∀ (E : Index l Ω)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y),
      (α E E le_rfl).hom.app K ≫
        (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g).map
          ((isomorphismCoefficientIntegralUnitor l Ω Y E).hom.app K) =
      (isomorphismCoefficientIntegralUnitor l Ω X E).hom.app
        ((constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g).obj K)) ∧
    (∀ (E : Index l Ω)
    (K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y),
      (rationalPullbackScalarComparison l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
          (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) (isomorphismCoefficientInclusion l Ω E E le_rfl) g).hom.app K ≫
        (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g).map
          ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.unitor l Ω Y E).hom.app K) =
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.unitor l Ω X E).hom.app
        ((rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g).obj K))
